title: Fixtures and hidden tests

## You write a test the hidden runner also runs

`cases.json` is a fixture: `[{ "dirs": ["east"], "n": 1 }]`. `testWalk` reads it and asserts `walkLength`.

Print `ok` when all fixture cases pass.
